purpose: Document, with reproducible evidence, which data sources are reachable from this execution environment. Required before any figure can be assigned a source URL + retrieval date under HARD RULE R3.

WebFetch_server_side.conclusion: WebFetch is governed by the same allowlist. Developer infrastructure passes; the entire financial and reference web is denied.

WebSearch.returns: result titles, URLs, and a backend-synthesized summary of snippets
WebSearch.critical_limitation: Returns synthesized snippet summaries only. The underlying documents CANNOT be opened, so no figure obtained this way can be verified against its cited source.

empirical_yield_test.note: Two probe searches run to measure what WebSearch can actually deliver on real line items, rather than speculating.

contaminated: capex quoted as '-$12.72B' from a third-party aggregator, not the filing

D&A returned as a TTM ending 2025-06-30 from macrotrends - a period that does NOT match the FY2025 fiscal year ending 2025-09-27. Silently combining these would corrupt any owner-earnings calculation.

impact_on_mandated_deliverable.required_datapoints_estimate: 52 companies x ~11 line items x 5-10 years = 3,000-5,700 figures, each requiring a verified primary source
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.principle_1_ROIC_10yr_and_incremental: NOT COMPUTABLE - requires invested-capital history (balance sheet series). Unobtainable via search snippets.
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.principle_2_ROE_vs_ROIC_spread_debt: NOT COMPUTABLE - requires equity, interest-bearing debt, EBITDA, interest expense series.
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.principle_3_owner_earnings: NOT COMPUTABLE - requires D&A, CapEx and change in working capital on matched fiscal periods. Probe showed period mismatch is the default failure mode.
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.principle_5_6_DCF_intrinsic_value: NOT COMPUTABLE - depends on all of the above plus beta/WACC inputs.
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.phase_6_A6_verification: STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE - the spec requires re-fetching each source URL to confirm it exists and contains the figure. No URL can be fetched.
impact_on_mandated_deliverable.confidence_grade_HIGH: UNREACHABLE BY DEFINITION - grade 'HIGH' requires direct primary-document confirmation plus two independent corroborating sources.

conclusion: The mandated analysis cannot be completed to the evidentiary standard the task itself defines. Completing it anyway would require populating roughly 90% of figures from model memory and attaching source URLs that were never opened - the exact failure mode the task designates as its single worst outcome ('추측으로 빈칸을 채우는 것은 이 작업의 최대 실패'). Work is halted for a data-access decision rather than proceeding into fabrication.
not_a_transient_error: Per /root/.ccr/README.md, 403/407 responses are organization egress-policy denials and must be reported, not retried or routed around. These were not retried.
